name: Cá chiên
summary: Cá chiên is fried fish for the rice, listed apart from cá cháy and from the grilled dried fish, and the spice stays light.
origin: Cham Islands. The daily catch on Tân Hiệp, eaten with rice.
howToEat: With rice, at the midday or evening meal. Lunch is about 11:00–12:00 and the evening meal about 17:00–18:00.
where: Bai Lang and the other hamlets.
seoTitle: Cá chiên — fried fish on the Cham Islands
seoDescription: Fried fish in the daily rice on Tân Hiệp, listed apart from cá cháy and grilled dried fish.
